title: Status on 50 Intents and 200 runs takes under 1 s (reported; fails only above 5 s)

steps.sh:
set -e
i=0
while [ $i -lt 50 ]; do
  s=$(printf 'perf-%02d' $i)
  mkdir -p .kogen/intents/$s .kogen/acceptance
  sed "s/Greet Almir by name/Perf $s/" "{templates}/intents/greet/intent.md" > .kogen/intents/$s/intent.md
  cp "{templates}/intents/greet/test.t.sh" .kogen/acceptance/$s.t.sh
  i=$((i + 1))
done
git add -A .kogen && git commit -q -m "50 Intents"
root="{state_root}/runs"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 200 ]; do
  id=$(printf '%032x' $((i + 4096)))
  s=$(printf 'perf-%02d' $((i % 50)))
  mkdir -p "$root/$id"
  printf '{"schema":2,"run_id":"%s","slug":"%s","approval_sha256":"%064d","approval_commit":"%040d","target_branch":"main","status":"failed","landing":null,"owner_pid":1,"owner_started_ms":1,"started_ms":%d}\n' $id $s 0 0 $((1700000000000 + i)) > "$root/$id/run.json"
  printf '{"event":"started","ts":%d}\n{"event":"finished","ts":%d,"status":"failed","reason":"repair_cap","rung":"R1","verdict":"unverified","advisory_items":[]}\n' $((1700000000000 + i)) $((1700000000001 + i)) > "$root/$id/events.jsonl"
  i=$((i + 1))
done
